title_hook: You're not short on energy. You're spread too thin.
concept: The lens - scattered light warms, gathered light burns
quote: Scattered, you feel busy. Focused, you become dangerous.
core_metaphor: Sunlight through a lens: nothing added, everything gathered.
primary_prompt: 9:16 vertical cinematic sequence: thousands of scattered gold light rays drifting in a black void converge through a flawless glass lens into one blazing point that smokes, ignites, and holds as a controlled flame.

hook.text: You are not short on energy. You are spread too thin to burn.
hook.visual: 9:16 vertical, black void (#0A0A0F): thousands of thin gold (#C6A94F) light rays drifting in every direction like scattered filaments, weak and diffuse, none touching. Slow drift, cold, directionless. Camera static, center frame empty.

build.text: The same sunlight that warms a field can set a single point on fire. Nothing was added. Nothing got stronger. It was gathered.
build.visual: A precision glass lens rises into frame from below, flawless optical geometry. The scattered gold rays bend toward it one by one, converging through the glass. Clean refractions, bone-white (#F5F2EB) caustics on the lens rim. Smooth slow motion.

pivot.text: Scattered, you feel busy. Focused, you become dangerous. The difference is not effort. It is aperture.
pivot.visual: Extreme close-up of the focal point: all light compressed into a single blazing pinpoint on a dark matte surface. The surface begins to glow crimson (#DC143C), then a thin thread of smoke rises straight up. Macro, forensic, high contrast.

resolution.text: Close the tabs. Drop the side quests. Pick the one point that matters and hold the light there until it smokes.
resolution.visual: Medium shot: the pinpoint ignites into a small controlled flame on the black surface, steady and intense, gold light reflecting in the lens above. Camera slowly orbits a quarter turn. Calm, deliberate.

mobius_close.text: Because the world does not reward how much light you have. It rewards where you...
mobius_close.visual: Wide shot pulling back: the lens tilts and the light begins to scatter again into drifting gold filaments across the void, returning to the opening geometry. Cold, quiet, unresolved.

caption: Same sunlight. Different result. Energy isn't your problem. Aperture is. Pick the point and hold the light there.
